profile.name: Aldrin Bangayan
profile.bio: I'm Aldrin Bangayan, a Computer Science graduate and creative developer who enjoys turning ideas into functional and visually engaging digital experiences. My background combines software development, graphic design, web development, and multimedia, allowing me to approach projects from both the technical and creative side. I enjoy building things, experimenting with new technologies, and continuously turning ideas into projects.

missions.title: Tuguegarao FloodWatch
missions.description: An IoT-based flood monitoring and visualization system designed to monitor water levels and provide real-time flood information through a desktop-based monitoring interface.

missions.title: Inventory Management System
missions.description: An inventory management system designed to simplify product tracking and inventory operations, with QR-code integration for faster identification and management.

missions.title: Unity Game
missions.description: A small experimental Unity game created as part of an ongoing weekly project challenge focused on learning, experimentation, and game development.
